title: Jason Licht: We love Baker Mayfield, our feelings for him haven't changed

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jason Licht: We love Baker Mayfield, our feelings for him haven't changed
sources.description: Baker Mayfield made his feelings about his contract clear when he told reporters last week that he was feeling "disrespected" and "undervalued" by the Buccaneers.
